Function reference

Package overview

silentema-package silentema
silentema: dynamic missingness graphs and sensitivity analysis for EMA data

  • Declare and check: dynamic missingness graphs

    • Build a dm-graph from the motif taxonomy, query it, and read the recoverability report.

    dm_graph()
    Declare a dynamic missingness graph (dm-graph)
    plot(<dm_graph>)
    Plot a dm-graph
    dsep()
    d-separation in a dm-graph
    recoverability()
    Recoverability report for a dm-graph

  • Test: was silence informative?
    • silence_test()
    The silence test: does the state after a skipped prompt differ?
    sensor_gap_test()
    The sensor-gap test: does an always-observed sensor differ at skipped prompts?
    fatigue_check()
    Descriptive check for burden or fatigue in the response sequence

  • Estimate the two-level VAR(1)
    • make_pairs()
    Build adjacent prompt pairs from long experience-sampling data
    fit_pairs()
    Within-person VAR(1) estimated from complete adjacent prompts
    summary(<pairs_fit>) coef(<pairs_fit>) vcov(<pairs_fit>) confint(<pairs_fit>) nobs(<pairs_fit>)
    Standard errors and confidence intervals for the lagged coefficients
    fit_ipw()
    Inverse-probability-weighted within-person VAR(1) for observed context confounding
    fit_fiml()
    Full-information maximum likelihood under missing at random (state-space EM)
    loglik_fiml()
    Log-likelihood of the two-level VAR(1) at given parameters (MAR)

  • Sensitivity analysis for self-censoring
    • fit_tilt()
    Tilted (self-censoring-adjusted) within-person VAR(1) at a fixed sensitivity value
    tilt_profile()
    Sensitivity profile over a grid of self-censoring values
    plot(<tilt_profile>)
    Plot a tilt profile
    break_even()
    Break-even sensitivity values and identified sets from a tilt profile
    bounds_support()
    Worst-case (support) bounds for person means under arbitrary nonresponse

  • Calibrate the sensitivity value
    • calibrate_delta()
    Calibrate the self-censoring sensitivity value from a design feature
    plot(<delta_calibration>)
    Plot the model-implied curve of a calibration
    simulate_from_fit()
    Simulate data from a fitted tilt model

  • Report
    • missingness_declaration()
    Missingness declaration for preregistrations and reports

    Simulation and population parameters

    simulate_ema()
    Simulate experience-sampling data with a declared missingness mechanism
    default_params()
    Default population parameters used in the simulation studies of Yu (2026)
    stationary_cov()
    Stationary covariance of a VAR(1) process
    partial_cors()
    Partial correlations from a covariance matrix
